title: Hunts FH-043: Implement Expedition teams

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 5, Extended rules. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Invite and roster lock, scoped progress and deterministic award allocation. Add departure recovery. Done when: Outsider and departed participant cannot mutate team run. Duplicate member claim yields one team credit. Requires: FH-008, FH-030, FH-033. Owner role: Identity and game systems.
